 name: DevSecOps Pipeline
 
 on:
   push:
     branches:
       - main
   pull_request:
     branches:
       - main
 
 permissions:
   contents: read
 
 jobs:
   build:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     env:
       IMAGE_NAME: cs763-student-demo:${{ github.sha }}
     steps:
       - name: Check out source
         uses: actions/checkout@v7
       - name: Set up Java 25
         uses: actions/setup-java@v6
         with:
           distribution: temurin
           java-version: '25'
           cache: maven
       - name: Make Maven wrapper executable
         run: chmod +x mvnw
       - name: Set up Python for Semgrep
         uses: actions/setup-python@v7
         with:
           python-version: '3.12'
       - name: Install Semgrep
         run: python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check semgrep
       - name: Run tests
         working-directory: ./functional-codebase
         run: ./mvnw -B test
       - name: Scan source with Semgrep
         run: semgrep scan --config p/default --metrics=off ./functional-codebase
       - name: Package application
         working-directory: ./functional-codebase
         run: ./mvnw -B package -DskipTests
       - name: Cache SonarQube packages
         uses: actions/cache@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4.3.0
         with:
           path: ~/.sonar/cache
           key: ${{ runner.os }}-sonar
           restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-sonar
       - name: Cache Maven packages
         uses: actions/cache@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4.3.0
         with:
           path: ~/.m2
           key: ${{ runner.os }}-m2-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
           restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-m2
       - name: Run SonarQube analysis
         working-directory: ./functional-codebase
         env:
           SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN_FUNCTIONAL }}
         run: ./mvnw -B verify org.sonarsource.scanner.maven:sonar-maven-plugin:sonar -Dsonar.projectKey=chloewildman_cs763-functional-codebase
       - name: Build Docker image
         run: docker build --tag "$IMAGE_NAME" ./functional-codebase
       - name: Scan Docker image with Trivy
         uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@v0.36.0
         with:
           image-ref: ${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}
           format: table
           exit-code: '0'
           ignore-unfixed: true
           vuln-type: os,library
           severity: CRITICAL,HIGH

 # Research Blog & Project Discussion Board
 
 Spring Boot REST service for scoped academic announcements, project update posts, nested comments, moderation, search, and timeline reads.
 
 ## Run and test
 
 From the repository root:
 
 ```powershell
 .\mvnw.cmd -f functional-codebase\pom.xml spring-boot:run
 .\mvnw.cmd -f functional-codebase\pom.xml test
 ```
 
 The service listens on port `8080` and uses an in-memory H2 database. To build and run the container with `functional-codebase` as the build context:
 
 ```powershell
 docker build -t research-discussion-board functional-codebase
 docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 research-discussion-board
 ```
 
 ## API
 
 All routes are under `/api/v1/discussions`.
 
 | Method | Route | Purpose |
 | --- | --- | --- |
 | `POST`, `GET` | `/posts` | Create/list posts; list supports `keyword`, `projectId`, `courseId`, `labId`, `category`, `authorHandle`, `from`, and `to`. |
 | `GET`, `PUT`, `DELETE` | `/posts/{postId}` | Read, replace, or delete a post. |
 | `GET` | `/scopes/{projects\|courses\|labs}/{scopeId}/timeline` | Read a chronological scoped timeline; accepts `keyword`, `category`, `from`, and `to`. |
 | `POST`, `GET` | `/posts/{postId}/comments` | Create/list nested comments; listing supports `keyword`, `authorHandle`, `from`, and `to`. Use `?format=text` to download a text manifest. |
 | `GET`, `PUT`, `DELETE` | `/posts/{postId}/comments/{commentId}` | Read, edit, or delete a comment. |
 | `PATCH` | `/posts/{postId}/moderation` | Set a post status to `active`, `reported`, or `hidden_by_moderator`. |
 | `PATCH` | `/posts/{postId}/comments/{commentId}/moderation` | Set a comment moderation status. |
 
 Post categories are `ACADEMIC_ANNOUNCEMENT` and `PROJECT_UPDATE_BLOG`. A post request must provide exactly one of `projectId`, `courseId`, or `labId`. Comment requests use `message`, `authorHandle`, and an optional `parentCommentId`. Hiding a post hides its comment stream; hiding a comment also hides its recursive replies.
 
 The specification does not define an authentication or faculty identity provider. Moderation routes currently perform status management without role authorization and must be protected by the institution's authentication layer before public deployment.

The workflow runs Maven from `functional-codebase`, but calls `./mvnw` there. The wrapper is at the repository root, and the `chmod +x mvnw` step makes that root-level wrapper executable. As written, the test step will fail because `functional-codebase/mvnw` does not exist.

Change the command at [devsecops.yml:38](C:/Users/wildm/Documents/Projects/cs763-wildman-final-project/cs763-wildman-final-project/.github/workflows/devsecops.yml:38) to `../mvnw -B test`. Apply the same path correction to the package and Sonar steps at [devsecops.yml:43](C:/Users/wildm/Documents/Projects/cs763-wildman-final-project/cs763-wildman-final-project/.github/workflows/devsecops.yml:43) and [devsecops.yml:60](C:/Users/wildm/Documents/Projects/cs763-wildman-final-project/cs763-wildman-final-project/.github/workflows/devsecops.yml:60), since they also run from `functional-codebase`.

This matches the root-wrapper invocation documented in [README.md:11](C:/Users/wildm/Documents/Projects/cs763-wildman-final-project/cs763-wildman-final-project/functional-codebase/README.md:11). The functional test class is present at [DiscussionApiFunctionalTests.java:29](C:/Users/wildm/Documents/Projects/cs763-wildman-final-project/cs763-wildman-final-project/functional-codebase/src/test/java/edu/bu/met/wildmancs763/discussions/DiscussionApiFunctionalTests.java:29).
